item.title: [7.6] Why US stocks are falling today: Dow Jones crashes 600 points on Trump threat to intensify US-Canada trade war amid oil price rise
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Dow Jones dropped significantly as US President Donald Trump threatened Bombardier's market access. This escalation followed Canada's refusal to certify American Gulfstream jets, sparking counter tariffs. Brent crude futures rose above ninety-seven dollars a barrel after Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure.

WHY IT MATTERS

A 600-point Dow drop driven by escalating US-Canada trade tensions and a major oil price spike presents a material risk to near-term market sentiment and Fed policy expectations.
